events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: John Cleese, a true titan of British comedy, celebrates his 87th birthday! From the Ministry of Silly Walks to Basil Fawlty's outbursts, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968, showcasing the band's diverse musical directions.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'! A double LP packed with everything from rock to folk, showcasing their incredible versatility. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His incredible voice and electrifying stage presence continue to inspire generations. A true legend, never forgotten.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Game Changer
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' – an album that changed the game for pop and rock music. Which track from this masterpiece still gets you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of John Lennon, the legendary singer-songwriter and member of The Beatles, who passed away in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years since we lost a true musical visionary. His songs continue to resonate globally, inspiring peace and imagination.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic and influential musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator whose music and artistry continue to transcend generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have turned 92 today! Still shaking up playlists worldwide.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs are etched into rock history. What's your favourite Page solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Sir Rod Stewart is 82 today! With a career spanning decades and a voice instantly recognisable, he's still got it. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Our House is celebrating! Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, turns 66 today. What's your favourite track from the kings of Camden?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer Paul Young, known for his blue-eyed soul hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul Star
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! The voice behind some of the 80s' smoothest hits. Wherever you lay your hat today, we hope it's a good one!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon, singer-songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: The one and only Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday! A true force of nature in music and beyond. What's your favourite Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That's Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From chart-topping hits to incredible songwriting, a true British music talent.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s R&B-tinged pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean King of Pop
angles.copy: Get outta our dreams and into our cars! Billy Ocean turns 77 today. The voice behind 'Caribbean Queen' and many more timeless tracks.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneering legends.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors for the very first time! Who do you think was the most deserving of those inaugural inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member and solo artist Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That's early days to his solo ventures, he's been a constant on the pop scene.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Rooftop Rock
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert! The final live performance, a moment etched in music legend. What's your favourite moment from that day?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed drummer, singer-songwriter, and actor Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! From Genesis to his massive solo hits, his talent behind the kit and on the mic is undeniable.
